observations: G-11 observes the explicit `evidence_incomplete` counter and `requests_received` on an armed submission (evidence_incomplete==0). It demonstrates the counter is present and bounded; T033-SR-013 does not require forcing a non-zero evidence-incomplete count, so this is informational, not a repair-requiring defect.

Gateway check G-09 verifies the granted and buffer bounds plus the close counters but does not itself assert payload emptiness on the read records; T033-SR-011 requires only the granted-record bound, so this is informational.

The gateway suite null-checks only the first fixture returned by the subject seam; the supplied FactoryGatewaySubject always returns a valid fixture and no requirement mandates hostile-factory handling, so the later-group dereferences are a non-blocking robustness observation.

T033-STK-004 mentions zero items from invalid or expired sessions; the suite demonstrates zero emission for an unarmed session (G-08) and an unsupported protocol major (G-04). The explicit clock-expiry case remains covered by the accepted T032 client suite and is not weakened; T033-SR-010 requires only the unarmed case.

The eight executed cases exercise the named provider, observer, stimulation-tool, and gateway behavior deterministically, fail-closed on version/framing/permit/zero-emission, with bounded resources and no TCP listener or external peer.
